(GPI)''' is a British-founded [[tobacco]] manufacturer headquartered in India. It is now a part of [[Modi Enterprises]]. The company is a major player in the domestic cigarette industry. In 2013-2014 it reported an annual turnover of {{INRConvert|42.2|b|lk=r|year=2014}}. It has expanded from tobacco to include tea, pan masala, and confectioner. Its operations are primarily located in the northern and western parts of India, but it has recently expanded into West Bengal and the southern part of the country. It sells some of the most popular cigarette brands, such as Four Square, Red and White, Cavanders, Tipper, and North Pole.Kameswara Rao Poranki, "The Impact of Brand Awareness on Customer Satisfaction: A Case Study of Godfrey Phillips India Limited, India." ''Research Journal of Social Science & Management'' 5.1 (2015): 38-44. The firm was originally established in London in 1844. GPI was one of the first [[Smoking in the United Kingdom|British]] companies to mass-produce [[cigarette]]s. GPI manufactures and sells [[cigarette]]s, smoking tobacco and cigars,[https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/godfrey-philips-india-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13707.cms Godfrey Phillips India History] on Economic Times.com apart from having a non-tobacco line of products released in 2009 that include [[confectionery]].{{cite web|url=https://www.godfreyphillips.com/company/our-brands/|title=Our Brands|website=godfreyphillips.com}} GPI is the flagship company of [[Modi Group|Modi Enterprises]].{{cite web|url=https://www.godfreyphillips.com/company/who-we-are/about-us/|title=About Us|website=godfreyphillips.com|access-date=4 April 2022|archive-date=19 May 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220519054513/https://www.godfreyphillips.com/company/who-we-are/about-us/|url-status=dead}} The company had an annual turnover of approximately {{INRConvert|29.26|b|year=2021}} as of March 2021.{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/godfrey-phillips-india-ltd/profitandlose/companyid-13707.cms|title=Godfrey Phillips India Profit and Loss Reports|website=The Economic Times}} The company also has business interests in pan masala, chewing and confectionery products. The company also manufactures and distributes [[Marlboro (cigarette)|Marlboro]] in India under a licence agreement with [[Philip Morris International]]. ==History== The house of Godfrey Phillips was established in 1844 at Bevis Marks in Aldgate, London, by cigar manufacturer Godfrey Phillips, who was the eldest son of Henry Phillips, born in the country fields outside London in October 1826.‘G.P.‘ Enters Its Hundredth Year, By Arthur I. Phillips, Chairman and Managing Director, published in the journal "Tobacco" in 1940 When his sons were old enough and working in the business, the firm's name was changed to Godfrey Phillips & Sons, Ltd. On 21 August 1900GRO death certificate Godfrey Phillips died and in 1908 the partnership was sold, and Godfrey Phillips, Limited, was formed. The first directors were the partners- Joseph Phillips, chairman, Philip Phillips, David Phillips, Spencer Phillips and Arthur Phillips. Later, the business was listed on the London Stock Exchange as Godfrey Phillips Plc. In 1936, Godfrey Phillips (India), Limited, was created; the building of native-style architecture was devoted to the manufacture of the group's brands Cavander's, De Reszke and Greys. In 1967, Godfrey Phillips Ltd. of London made an arrangement with International Tobacco Co. who opened a factory in Northern India to manufacture on the company's behalf. Upon the merger with D. Macropolo & Co. Ltd., International Tobacco Co. Ltd. became its subsidiary. In 1968, [[Philip Morris Inc.]] made a [[takeover bid]] for Godfrey Phillips Plc and the family shareholders were unable to prevent the company being sold. Godfrey Phillips India has manufacturing facilities at [[Rabale]] in [[Navi Mumbai]], and two units in [[Ghaziabad]] (near [[Delhi]]). They also have an R&D centre in [[Mumbai]] and a food R&D in Ghaziabad, and a tobacco-buying unit in [[Guntur]] ([[Andhra Pradesh]]). Godfrey Phillips India has an International Business Division, for international export of its own cigarette brands, cut & blended tobacco, tobacco leaf and providing technical services and contract manufacturing. In 2011, Modi Enterprises acquire majority control in Godfrey Philips from Philip Morris, Philip Morris' stake down to 21%.{{Cite news |date=2011-06-23 |title=KK Modi eyes 51% in Godfrey Phillips |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/kk-modi-eyes-51-in-godfrey-phillips/articleshow/8958822.cms |access-date=2023-11-28 |issn=0971-8257}} ==Brands and products== GPI manufactures a variety of products related to tobacco through its subsidiary brands. Godfrey Phillips India also manufactures and distributes cigarette brand [[Marlboro (cigarette)|Marlboro]] under a licence agreement with [[Philip Morris International|Philip Morris International Inc]]. Likewise, the company also has a non-tobacco range of products. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align:left; width:500px; font-size:100%" |- ! width=100px| Product ! width=400px| Brand/s |- | [[Cigarette]]s || Cavanders, Four Square, [[Marlboro (cigarette)|Marlboro]] (owned by [[Philip Morris International|Philip Morris]]), Red & White, Stellar, North Pole, Tipper |- | [[Tobacco|Tobacco leaf]] || – {{refn|GPI is tobacco provider of companies such as Philip Morris, ITG, JTI, Eastern Co., European Tobacco, Libyan Tobacco Company and RNTA.|group=note|name=leaf}} |- | [[Candy|Candies]] || Funda Goli |- | [[Paan|Pan masala]] || Pan Vilas |- |[[Vaporizer (inhalation device)|Vapes]] |Verge |} ;Notes {{Reflist|group=note}} ==Collectables== ===Cigarette cards=== Godfrey Phillips Ltd. also produced a variety of [[cigarette card]]s to advertise their products, with topics such as film actresses, animals, aircraft, famous people from history, cricketers and footballers amongst others. The first cards set was launched in 1904 and featured anonymous [[pin-up]] girls.[https://www.doaks.org/research/library-archives/dumbarton-oaks-archives/collections/ephemera/names/godfrey-phillips Godfrey Phillips, Ltd.] on Dumbarton Oaks website In the 1920s, the company took advantage of the rise popularity of [[association football trading card]]s in those times, releasing football collections in 1920, 1922 and 1923. Godfrey Phillips Ltd. issued a series of 1,100 football cards of the first collection, followed by 2,462 in 1922 and 940 in 1923. The outbreak of the [[World War II]] caused a severe shortage of paper, and tobacco companies were forced to bring an end to the production of cigarette cards.[https://spartacus-educational.com/Fcigarette.htm The History of Football Cigarette Cards] by John Simkin, on Spartacus Educational, September 1997 {{center|'''Godfrey Phillips cigarette cards'''}} File:Soldier corporal mayor card.jpg|Corporal Mayor, "Types of British Soldiers", 1900 File:Godfrey card marsh.jpg|[[Marian Marsh]], "Film Favorites", 1934 File:Great northern railw card.jpg|[[Great Northern Railway (Great Britain)|Great Northern Railway]] locomotive, 1934 File:Chip off godfrey card.jpg|Dogs, "Animals" series, 1935 File:Davinci godfrey card.jpg|[[Leonardo da Vinci]], "Famous Minors" series, 1936 File:Phillips card boyes.jpg|[[Walter Boyes]] of [[West Bromwich Albion F.C.|West Bromwich]], 1936 File:Godfrey phillips colbert cleopatra.jpg|[[Claudette Colbert]] as Cleopatra, 1938 ===Flat toy soldiers=== In the 1930s, the Godfrey Phillips' brand 'Greys' included tin alloy flat-cast [[toy soldiers]] in place of cigarette cards.{{cite book |last1=Opie |first1=James |title=Toy Soldiers |date=1983 |publisher=[[Shire Albums]] |location=[[Princes Risborough]] |isbn=9780852636329 |page=4 |edition=1st |language=en |chapter=}} These included German-manufactured Ochel figures depicting horsemen of the [[Royal Scots Greys]] cavalry regiment regiment of the [[Cavalry regiments of the British Army|British Army]] at a nonstandard 28mm scale. ==See also== {{Portal|Companies}} * [[Smoking in India]] * [[ITC Limited]], the largest tobacco company *[[Smoking in Bollywood]] * [[Modi Group|Modi Enterprises]] * [[Association football trading card]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==Further reading== * Debarun, Chakraborty. Godfrey Phillips India Ltd. (GPI) is a British-founded tobacco manufacturer headquartered in India. It is now a part of Modi Enterprises. The company is a major player in the domestic cigarette industry. In 2013-2014 it reported an annual turnover of ₹42.2 billion (equivalent to ₹67 billion or US$700 million in 2023). It has expanded from tobacco to include tea, pan masala, and confectioner. Its operations are primarily located in the northern and western parts of India, but it has recently expanded into West Bengal and the southern part of the country. It sells some of the most popular cigarette brands, such as Four Square, Red and White, Cavanders, Tipper, and North Pole.
The firm was originally established in London in 1844. GPI was one of the first British companies to mass-produce cigarettes. 
GPI manufactures and sells cigarettes, smoking tobacco and cigars, apart from having a non-tobacco line of products released in 2009 that include confectionery. GPI is the flagship company of Modi Enterprises.
The company had an annual turnover of approximately ₹29.26 billion (equivalent to ₹33 billion or US$340 million in 2023) as of March 2021. The company also has business interests in pan masala, chewing and confectionery products. The company also manufactures and distributes Marlboro in India under a licence agreement with Philip Morris International.
